description: This file defines a Python class 'WindowsSDKApi' that provides an API for managing Windows SDK environments, including setup, ensuring SDK installation, and environment configuration, specifically for use within a build or automation system.

classes.name: WindowsSDKApi
classes.description: API class for managing Windows SDK setup, environment configuration, and ensuring SDK installation via CIPD.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the WindowsSDKApi with SDK package and version properties.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Sets up the Windows SDK environment, no-op on non-Windows platforms, and kills background processes after use.

methods.name: _ensure_sdk
methods.description: Ensures the Windows SDK CIPD package is installed and returns the SDK directory path.

methods.name: _sdk_env
methods.description: Constructs environment variables for the SDK based on JSON configuration files.
